propositions: A ticket with oversized context (34,282 and 41,595 chars measured) cannot close via bounded recovery because the context limit is 24,000 chars, yet the criteria budget is higher at 32,000 chars, creating an incoherent bound interaction.

When completion recovery fails due to step budget exhaustion after running the model, the close gate incorrectly reports the false remedy 'install the agents extra' instead of the actual CompletionRecoveryError diagnostic because recovery_failure_cause() returns None for non-CompletionRecoveryError exceptions.

The context bound of 24,000 chars must be raised to 100,000 chars to cover real blocked tickets with headroom, and the bound enforcement must remain a fail-closed cost safeguard with zero billable recovery calls on breach.

The close gate remedy selection must switch from exception-type dispatch to cause-based dispatch so that step-budget failures accurately report their own diagnostic rather than inheriting a generic missing-dependency message.

An alternative compaction approach that drops comment history to fit over-cap context was withdrawn because on epics it silently deletes entire child tickets and their unmet criteria while misreporting it as comment elision, creating a signed-false-PASS vector.
The criteria-vs-context cap incoherence must be pinned by an invariant test so _MAX_TOTAL_CRITERIA_CHARS cannot exceed the context cap, preventing recurrence of the mutual bound contradiction.
